criteria.criterion: Apply GitHub PR filters (open, non-draft) and sort by most recently updated
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: there is clear visual evidence (screenshots 2/3) that the correct qualifiers were applied.

criteria.criterion: Inspect the first three results after filtering/sorting
criteria.final_justification: Downscore: the agent did inspect three PRs, but the third inspected PR (#7543) was not the third result in the required filtered/sorted list (it should have been #7579 per screenshot 3). This is a controllable selection error, not an external blocker.

Partial credit: most required fields for #7506 are visually supported (number, title, author, labels=none, files/additions/deletions, and no test file via `src/requests/help.py`). However, the agent claimed a specific last-updated date that is not shown in the screenshots, so that field is unverified/likely fabricated.

Major downscore: agent’s reported title/author/labels/additions/deletions/last-updated for #7586 contradict the screenshots. The only correct part supported is that 2 files changed and a test file is included. Because multiple required fields are wrong or unsupported, award minimal partial credit.

Downscore: although the agent did inspect #7543 and file stats are verifiable, the agent’s reported metadata (title/author/labels/last-updated) for this PR is contradicted by screenshots. Since several required fields are wrong, only limited credit is warranted.

criteria.criterion: Verify presence of test files in 'Files changed' for each PR
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit on the underlying verification task: regardless of other inaccuracies, the screenshots support correct test-file determinations for each of the three inspected PRs (#7586 yes; #7506/#7543 no).

criteria.criterion: Rank the three PRs by changed-file count
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: ranking by changed-file count is supported by screenshots (#7586 highest; #7506 and #7543 tied). Even though the agent mis-identified the 'first three results' overall, this criterion only concerns ranking the three PRs they discussed.

criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: evidence supports no sign-in and no PR modifications; the agent appears to have only viewed pages/tabs.
